data.name: GroupedTotalsGrid_Desc
data.value: Shows a view grouped by any column, including lookups, with per-group and grand totals rendered in the platform's own cell formatting.

data.name: CurrencyColumn_Desc
data.value: Bind to transactioncurrencyid so mixed-currency groups can be detected.

data.name: GroupByColumn_Desc
data.value: Optional. Logical name (not display name) of the column to group by, entered as a static value. Leave blank to let users choose from the column header menu; their choice is remembered per view and overrides this setting. Lookup columns are supported.

data.name: AllowRuntimeGroupChange_Desc
data.value: Shows Group by this column in the column header menu.

data.name: ShowRecordCounts_Desc
data.value: Shows the number of records beside each group label.

data.name: EmptyGroupLabel_Desc
data.value: Label for records with no value in the grouping column.

data.name: AggregateColumns_Desc
data.value: Comma-separated logical names. Leave blank to total every column in the view that can be totalled.

data.name: ShowGrandTotal_Desc
data.value: Pins a grand total row to the bottom of the grid.

data.name: TotalsMode_Desc
data.value: Auto uses server aggregation and falls back to loaded rows. ServerAggregate never falls back. ClientOnly never queries the server.

data.name: DurationDisplay_Desc
data.value: Auto matches how the platform formats the duration cells in the column.

data.name: MaxClientRows_Desc
data.value: Ceiling on rows pulled into the browser. Groups beyond this load their rows on expand.

data.name: NavigationTypesAllowed_Desc
data.value: Which cells render as hyperlinks. Mirrors the Power Apps grid control property of the same name.

data.name: EnableOptionSetColors_Desc
data.value: Renders choice columns with their configured background colours.

data.name: RowDensity_Desc
data.value: Platform follows the host setting or the native default.

data.name: EnableDebugLogging_Desc
data.value: Writes diagnostics to the browser console. Leave off in production.

data.name: Notice_BaseCurrency
data.value: This group contains more than one currency, so the total is shown in the base currency.

data.name: Notice_PartialTotals
data.value: Totals cover the records loaded so far, not the full result set.

data.name: Notice_CopyFailed
data.value: Could not copy to the clipboard.

data.name: Error_AggregateLimitMessage
data.value: This result set is too large for the platform to total in one query. Narrow the filter, or switch the control to Auto so it can fall back to loaded rows.
